messages:
Ivy M.: Starting a tiny thread to coordinate a docs PR that clarifies Optimize toolkit mappings for SDK v2 options -> runtime flags. PR link: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/12379

Noah B.: nice. main ask: map names users will see (batch_size, cache_mode, quant_profile) to internal flags (max_batch, kv_cache, quantize_type) in a small table. keeps support questions down.

Priya S.: add a short migration note for customers on dedicated: 'if you pinned to a model variant with different kv semantics, test before switching cache_mode'. also include a snippet showing how to set options in the JS SDK.

Ivy M.: agreed. i'll add table + three snippets (py sync, js streaming, node batch-embeds). keeping examples intentionally tiny so they run in CI.

Ethan R.: CI heads-up  the docs-snippets suite will run lint + a smoke run against the minimal examples. please avoid shelling out to real large models in examples, use tiny inputs.

Ivy M.: plan: sample inputs: 'Summarize: <short text>' for gen, 2-line chat stream, and 4 embeddings in one batch. will include env var guard for larger runs.

DocsBot: PR #12379 CI started  doc-snippets lint + smoke.

DocsBot: CI: 2 failures  js-snippet-lint (eslint), batch-embeds-timeout. logs: https://ci.redwood/inference/12379/logs

Noah B.: eslint nit: prefer `client.generate({ model, input, options })` object arg style for consistency with other examples. small commit incoming.

Ivy M.: changed js snippet to object-arg style and reduced embed batch from 64 to 16 for the smoke test. also added a comment: "increase for production". pushing update.

Ivy M.: pushed update at 2392001142  fixed js style and lowered batch. also added the table mapping and a tiny note about memory risk with kv cache on smaller GPUs.

DocsBot: CI re-run  all checks passed.

Priya S.: editorial request: add a one-sentence guidance under quant_profile: "use int8 for token-cost sensitive workloads; 4bit may change quality on long-context summarization". avoids saying absolute 'better'.

Ivy M.: added wording and a link to the quant-profiles deep dive doc. also included a small example showing quality-check prompt that teams can use to validate after quant switch.

Clara T.: UX/regression note: could we include a short checklist for migrating existing examples: (1) change options shape, (2) run smoke suite, (3) run perf harness if using >batch 8. I can paste a checklist commit.

Ivy M.: please do  that checklist is great for the PR description and the docs page. adding it now.

Noah B.: quick perf follow-up: i ran a short harness comparing fp16 vs int8 on summarization-long (batch=8, kv on). int8 reduces token cost ~1.6x but increases avg latency 10-15ms. posting numbers to the PR comments.

Ivy M.: perfect, i'll link those numbers in the docs matrix footnote so readers see tradeoffs.

DocsBot: PR #12379 merged into main at 2392001160  docs build queued. :rocket:

Ivy M.: thanks everyone. follow-up: i'll file a tiny issue to track telemetry for the new snippets and confirm no flaky behavior in the wild.

Priya S.: thanks  rounding this out now.
